rules: A task is passed only when its verify command exits 0 (run by harness/run_tasks.py).
Metrics come from artifacts/*.json written by real runs; never type a measured number by hand.
External services (Nebius, Tavily, PayPal Sandbox, Slack, Mattermost) are called only when their credentials are present in the environment.
Phase 2: gated targets are judged only by the pass flags aegis-bench writes into targets_summary (T18); a missed target fails T18 and stays recorded as pass: false.

The benchmark runs once per full harness pass (T17). T12 and T18 check the artifact that run wrote and fail on a stale (sources fingerprint differs from the working tree) or reduced-scale artifact; T18 also fails on a preliminary run (busy machine, see run_conditions).
